verdict.rationale: Skills are defined as plain filesystem artifacts: a directory with a human-readable SKILL.md (YAML frontmatter plus Markdown) and optional scripts/, references/ and assets/ folders. A hands-on probe confirmed an installed skill's SKILL.md lands in ./.claude/skills/ as clean, readable markdown, so every file can be read after installation. However, there is no documented first-party way to list or preview a skill's or plugin's contents before `/plugin install`, and the selective install in the probe used a third-party `npx skills` tool. missing for 10: documented pre-install content listing/preview in the plugin or marketplace flow, first-party guidance on auditing bundled scripts, independent corroboration of a review workflow.
